<div class="hero-title">
Methods
</div>
 
<div class="hero-subtitle">
This evidence map visualizes the existing evidence on the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in evidence synthesis. The use of AI to automate aspects of the evidence synthesis process is a rapidly evolving area of research, offering new approaches to address the growing volume and complexity of scientific literature.
 
This evidence map is intended to be <strong>living</strong>, with regular updates to capture both existing evidence and new evidence as it emerges.
</div>
